newsitem.title: JAPAN: JCR lowers Aoki Corp CB to BB- from BB+.
newsitem.headline: JCR lowers Aoki Corp CB to BB- from BB+.

text.p: Japan Credit Rating Agency Ltd (JCR) said on Friday that it had downgraded to BB- the BB+ rating it assigned to Aoki Corp's 20 billion yen worth of 5.5 percent convertible bonds due on March 31 1998.
JCR said in a statement that it had placed the bonds on credit monitor for further review.

It is likely to take some time for the construction company to improve its profits, due to a cut in Japanese government spending on public works projects and rising construction costs in the domestic market, the credit-rating company said.
Aoki's ability to repay debts and its financial health would remain weak as the company holds a large amount of debt, JCR said.

"Under the circumstances in which the profit margin of construction projects is expected to worsen further, the company is likely to face difficulties implementing its restructuring plan formed in January 1996," JCR said.
"It will be difficult for the company to cut its group debts immediately," JCR said.
